name: Sonatina Symphonic Orchestra (SF2)
description: A complete free orchestral library converted from the original SFZ release into SoundFont banks: strings, woodwinds, brass, percussion, piano, harpsichord and chorus. 398 MB zip, so expect a long download.

files.note: The original sample library is under the obsolete CC Sampling Plus 1.0 licence, which forbids commercial redistribution.
